prompt:
A bright, authentic DSLR photograph used as a YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 — one genuinely captured, candid-looking moment in a real office. The photo looks completely real; only one bold overlay word is added.

REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the identity reference — render this exact man with an identical face, beard, hair and skin tone, and match the real office visible behind him in Image 1: the soft grey-blue wall and the tall green dracaena plant. Do not stylize his face. Image 2 is a web app interface — reproduce this exact app on the laptop screen: cream-white page, left sidebar, and three large progress-ring cards with big numbers in purple, indigo and green. Keep the layout, colors and ring shapes faithful; all small interface text stays tiny and softly unreadable at this distance, and no large readable words appear on the screen.

SUBJECT & ACTION: the man from Image 1 sitting in his desk chair at his office desk, framed chest-up on the right half, caught mid-moment — big genuine amazed open-mouthed grin, raised eyebrows, wide bright eyes, looking straight into the lens while his right arm reaches toward the laptop, index finger pointing directly at the screen, fingertip almost touching it. That pointing hand is correctly formed with five fingers; his left hand rests on the desk edge; no other hands anywhere.

COMPOSITION: on the left half of the desk, an open laptop angled three-quarters toward the camera so the viewer sees the screen clearly, showing the app from Image 2 bright and crisp — the three colored rings clearly visible as the focal point of the screen. On the desk in soft focus: a keyboard, a coffee mug. The grey-blue wall and the tall green plant from Image 1 fill the softly blurred background with soft window daylight from the left.

LIGHTING & CAMERA: soft natural window daylight, realistic white balance and skin tones, gentle shadows, a faint cool glow from the laptop screen on his pointing hand; shot like a candid 35mm photo at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, sharp on his face, his pointing finger and the screen; natural, believable color grade — a real photo, not a composite.

TEXT: exactly ONE overlay element — "100% FREE" (characters 1-0-0-%, then F-R-E-E) in huge vivid-green condensed capitals with a subtle grunge texture and a hard drop shadow, across the top-left of the frame above the laptop. Absolutely no other text, numbers, badges, strips or logos anywhere else in the image.

STYLE: an authentic, warm, believable office photo elevated into a high-CTR thumbnail — bright, natural, premium, uncluttered; the single headline crisp, perfectly spelled and razor sharp.
